candidates.exact_span: If there is no discharge from any outfall during the sampling month, place an "X" in the NO DISCHARGE box located in the upper right corner of the Discharge Monitoring Report.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpreting whether no-discharge during a sampling month triggers a reporting obligation (B) and whether marking the NO DISCHARGE box establishes a documented no-discharge period versus unresolved missing-evidence (C) depends on how 'no discharge from any outfall during the sampling month' and the NO DISCHARGE box requirement are read.

candidates.exact_span: If any daily maximum or monthly average value exceeds the effluent limitations specified in Part I. A, the permittee shall report the excursion in accordance with the requirements of Part III. D.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Different readings of which statistics (daily maximum vs monthly average), which limit set applies (Part I.A effluent limitations), and when excursion reporting is required could change which enforceable limits are compared to reported values (A) and whether a monitoring/reporting obligation was triggered (B).

candidates.exact_span: Any daily maximum or monthly average value reported in the required Discharge Monitoring Report which is in excess of the effluent limitation specified in Part I. A shall constitute evidence of violation of such effluent limitation and of this permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a reported daily maximum or monthly average in excess of a Part I.A effluent limitation counts as evidence of exceedance/violation—and thus whether a measurement exceeds the applicable limit—turns on how 'in excess of the effluent limitation,' 'required Discharge Monitoring Report,' and the daily-max vs monthly-average comparison are interpreted.
